name: TU Wien
summary: Vienna's technical university: bachelor's from architecture to physics, all taught in German; its English-taught degrees are master's.

handoff.label: Bachelor's admission with a foreign school certificate

ib.text: German-taught degrees need German at C1. With A2 you can apply, but TU Wien then sets a supplementary German exam you must pass. No IB-specific rules are published.

notes: Informatics, Architecture and Spatial Planning have a capped selection procedure: for 2026 entry you registered 1 April to 4 May 2026, with ranking tests on 10 and 13 July.
If you miss that registration you wait a year, because the selection runs once a year, before the winter semester.
